title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
A fourth AI-generated bomb threat this school year was reported at Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a precaution, and normal operations later resumed. The latest incident follows a pattern seen in recent threats, which use a masked phone number to hide the caller's identity. Gwinnett County Public Schools police sent a letter to parents about the threat.

Gwinnett County school police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. No arrests have been made and no suspect has been identified. Authorities have not announced what specific steps come next, only that the investigation is ongoing and they are trying to find the source of the calls.
